info.name: Sinay Maritime APIs CO2 Emission Ports and Vessels API
Retrieve a list of vessels from a name, an MMSI or an IMO.

params.name: vesselNameOrCode
params.description: At least 3 letters of the vessel name, the MMSI or the IMO.

params.name: numberOfResult
params.description: Maximum number of results to return.

items.docs: Returns a list of none/one/several vessels matching the input. Provide at least three characters of the vessel name, or an MMSI / IMO number.

info.name: Retrieve a list of ports from a name or an unlocode.

params.name: portNameOrCode
params.description: At least 3 letters of the port name or the port code.

params.name: numberOfResult
params.description: Maximum number of results to return.

items.docs: Returns a list of ports matching the input. Provide at least three characters of the port name or the port UN/LOCODE.
